title: Vanilla+ | Fairplay
description: The Fairplay-Version of the official Zilan V+ Modpack
body:
Focus: Strict balance, anti-griefing, and protection of gameplay.

Strict fairness. No unfair advantages.

This modpack was developed specifically for use on servers where fairness is a top priority. Building on the optimized vanilla base, this version consistently avoids all quality-of-life mods that provide the player with critical information (such as extended combat HUDs). Instead, the focus is purely on anti-griefing tools, server security features, and cosmetic additions that enhance building without changing the game mechanics or progression. It offers the most original, competitive Vanilla+ experience, where your own skill counts and no one has an unfair advantage.

Keywords: Balance, transparency, anti-griefing, server focus, no gameplay-relevant client advantages.
